chat.disabledByOpponent: The other side turned the chat off. You cannot write now.
chat.disabledByOpponentReason: Writing is blocked: the other side turned the chat off.
chat.disabledByYou: You turned the chat off. You do not see the other side's messages and cannot write. They will see that the chat is off.
chat.empty: Nobody has written anything yet. Be the first.
chat.info: Messages are not kept for good: we delete them about an hour after the game ends, and at once when an account is deleted. Only the participants of the game see them. Each of them can turn the chat off in this game. The chat has no moderation and no abuse reporting.
chat.opponentDisabledPublic: The other side turned the chat off and will not see your messages. You can write to the spectators.
chat.readOnly: To write in the chat, come in with a nickname or signed in to an account. Without that you can only read.
chat.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the chat. We keep trying.

chat.rejection.combining_run: The message contains too many combining characters.
chat.rejection.control_char: The message cannot contain control characters or line breaks.
chat.rejection.invisible_char: The message cannot contain invisible characters.
chat.rejection.url: The message cannot contain web addresses.
chat.spectatorInfo: Messages are not kept for good: we delete them about an hour after the game ends, and at once when an account is deleted. Players and spectators see them. A player can turn the chat off for themselves — then they will not see your messages, but the others keep talking. The chat has no moderation and no abuse reporting.
chat.title: Chat
chat.turnOffFailed: Could not turn the chat off. Try again.
